derivationRule: Current official Grade 2 sample explicitly includes tonal as an identification target. Two independent explicit nonvisual definitions agree that tonal uses the PCCS intermediate/muddy tones sf (soft), d (dull), ltg (light grayish), and g (grayish). Power Color encodes only this four-tone membership and the fact that tonal combines such intermediate colors; it does not infer image appearance, exact tone-map geometry, RGB/HEX, monitor color, or additional numeric boundaries.
